nodes.text: 🟣 Live from the #EHMA2025 Focus Session! Experts discuss tackling RSV & hMPV in older and at-risk populations. Stronger surveillance, testing & cross-sector collaboration are key to closing data gaps and boosting public health response. Let’s bridge research & policy! 🌍🧪 https://t.co/ofauD4Gwvl

nodes.author: EHMAinfo
nodes.text:
Dr. Marta Nunes, Director at the @HCL_research is opening the session with a very interesting question: "Why focus on older adults"? 🤔

➡️Older adults face higher risk of respiratory diseases and they are a growing part of the population! 📈

nodes.author: EHMAinfo
nodes.text:
@HCL_research RSV-Associated hospitalizations in adults in the #EuropeanUnion data is strinking 🇪🇺 🏥

📊92% of these hospitalisations are among adults aged over 65!

nodes.author: EHMAinfo
nodes.text: @HCL_research Dr. Marta Nunes from @HCL_research introduce the audience to the #MOSAIC Framework from @WHO to address the evolving needs of respiratory viruses surveillance! 👏

nodes.author: EHMAinfo
nodes.text: @HCL_research @WHO The scene now belongs to Zach Desson, Principal Scientific and Policy Advisor at @EHMAinfo! 🎙️ https://t.co/vUzifr3ABr

nodes.author: EHMAinfo
EHMAinfo
nodes.text:
@HCL_research @WHO What barriers exist to improving #diagnosis, #testing and #surveillance? 🚧

🚑 Lack of available testing in ambulatory care.
📊Fragmented data collection.
👩‍🎓Insufficient training.

nodes.author: EHMAinfo
nodes.text: @HCL_research @WHO Dr. @PascalCrepey from @EHESP is our final speaker for today! He is Professor in Epidemiology and Biostatistics. https://t.co/kY0HkVwdoy

nodes.author: EHMAinfo
nodes.text:
@HCL_research @WHO @PascalCrepey @EHESP What characteristics define an effective epidemiological #surveillance system?

Reactive ⏲️
Representative 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
Sensitive and specific 🎯
Acceptable ✅
It provides quality data 📊
Cheap or cost-effective 💰
Useful 👏
